column1: # Game profile of The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles (Switch, base game v0 = 1.0.0, with its DLC 010036E00FB21001). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Capcom's MT Framework on SDK 10.4.1, NVN. Everything is under nativeNXx64/: ARC archives (version 7, zlib entries) of models (.mod / .mrl), textures (.tex), scripts and messages (.gmd),
# loose .tex files, Opus / ADPCM sound and 24 H.264 movies (.mp4; the SDK's movie extractor in subsdk0 runs natively, the decoder is the host's, hle_movie.c).
# Shaders: one MT Framework shader package (SPK, sc\NX_64\root in sa/NX_64/root.arc): 460 shaders, 230 vertex and 230 pixel, all of them build and every binding decodes.
# The package's own vertex / pixel combinations are not read, so the vertex shaders are paired with the single-stage cover (shader_split.py mtspk_shaders)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − 64 MB (3.14 GB), and main's bss is 9.2 MB. The 4 GB block of the other games
# without virtual address memory (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region); 1.07 GB resident on the Mac in the first episode's holding cell
# The engine keeps its textures in one 1000 MB CPU_CACHED | GPU_CACHED | COMPRESSIBLE pool (flags 0xa4). It reads each .tex into staging buffers (512 KB file reads) and copies the
# texels into the texture's storage with the CPU after nvnTextureInitialize: block-linear, no packaged layout, no WriteTexels, no nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange over them (only its
# linear text textures are flushed), and main has no cache maintenance at all. tex_dirty_upload uploads a registered texture whose pages the CPU wrote after creating it; with
# tex_flush_upload alone every texture read 0 and the screen stayed black
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; MT Framework SPK in an ARC archive) ----
